premises.text: Vendors unilaterally collect and leverage tracking data while consumers lack equivalent leverage
premises.evidence_span: Those with the vendors are the only ones that can be amassing and leveraging and tracking the data that's out there

premises.text: Forwarding order confirmations captures purchase history into the consumer's Schwope account
premises.evidence_span: all I need to do is forward my order confirmations in my inbox to wowat12.com

premises.text: Consumers augment purchase records with why/need context for mindful shopping and taste signaling
premises.evidence_span: augmenting the basic purchase data, the stuff that's like the what, the how much sort of thing, with the why

premises.text: A Shopify application makes the product data-compatible with tens of thousands of stores
premises.evidence_span: application with Shopify stores that makes us instantly data compatible with tens of thousands of stores

premises.text: Consumers can port selected shopping history outbound as a personal RFP for personalized deals and loyalty value
premises.evidence_span: the customer can take all that they've amassed and leverage it back for something of value in return, better deals, loyalty points, VIP programs

value.text: Consumers make shopping data meaningful and regain leverage over vendors
value.evidence_span: building tools for consumers to help them make their shopping data more meaningful

secondary_value.text: Opt-in data portability yields personalized merchant offers

causal_links.evidence_span: what if the consumers had as much leverage with the data as the vendors do
make their shopping data more meaningful
leverage it back for something of value in return

notes: Data-out / personal RFP coded as a premise because the speaker frames it as the disruptive value path, not mere aspiration. Social sharing roadmap folded into enrichment/GTM rather than split. ASR names (Schwab/Schwelp) left in spans.
